author: Jay
name: Foundry
short: Foundry VTT maintenance tasks via OliveTin.
description: Lets approved users trigger predefined Foundry VTT maintenance actions (like fixing file permissions) through an OliveTin instance. The bot never runs commands itself; it only asks OliveTin to run actions by ID.
install_msg: Set up with [p]foundryset url <olivetin url>, then DM the bot: [p]set api olivetin api_key,<key>
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
